errors.evidence: The blue line in the left diagram starts at 0 in 1995, peaks at 1 in 2010, and ends at 0.5 in 2020. The description incorrectly states values of 62, 58, and 65.

The description does not mention the purpose of the right diagram showing the IMF Fiscal Index in relation to the debt ratio of the central government.
